description: Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1833/27 dated 24. 10.2013 and hereby further amended by the repeal of items 6 and 7 of the Fourth Scheduled and substitution  therefor  of the items
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of regulations under the Motor Traffic Act by the Minister of Transport. It specifically modifies fee structures for vehicle number plates through statutory instruments, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new regulations, amendments to existing laws, and statutory instruments). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of issuing regulatory authority rather than detailing personal appointments or portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
